title: Elasticsearch ES|QL data-source and dataset registration can write storage credentials or pre-signed… (CVE-2026-133918)
description: A vulnerability in Elasticsearch ES|QL data-source and dataset registration allows storage credentials or pre-signed URL signatures to be written in plaintext to audit logs. This occurs because request definitions are not properly filtered before auditing the request body or URL query. The issue affects deployments with ES|QL federation enabled and audit logging configured to capture the relevant request data. An attacker with access to these audit logs could obtain sensitive external storage credentials.
